        "maxSteps": r["stepBudget"]["maxSteps"],
        "executedActions": r["stepBudget"]["executedActionCount"],
        "rejectedActions": r["stepBudget"]["rejectedActionCount"],
        "actionKinds": dict(collections.Counter(a["kind"] for a in r["stepBudget"]["actions"])),
        "pythonExecStatuses": dict(statuses), "kernelStates": dict(states),
        "agentStageCompletedBeforeEvaluator": stages["agent"]["completedAtUnix"] <= stages["evaluator"]["startedAtUnix"],
        "evaluatorBeforeTeardown": stages["evaluator"]["completedAtUnix"] <= stages["task_teardown"]["startedAtUnix"],

        "officialReward": r["officialReward"], "invalidReason": r.get("invalidReason"), "error": r.get("error")
    })
output = {"caseCount": len(rows), "allPromptGoalsExact": all(r["promptGoalExact"] for r in rows), "allTaskReferenceTimesVisible": all(r["promptReferenceTimeVisible"] for r in rows), "allStringSubmissionInstructionsVisible": all(r["promptStringSubmissionVisible"] for r in rows), "allArchivedParserResultsExact": all(r["archiveParserExactMatch"] for r in rows), "allSubmissionHashesMatch": all(r["archiveHashMatchesReceipt"] for r in rows), "allSubmissionsValidStrings": all(r["validContract"] and r["answerType"] == "string" for r in rows), "allEvaluatorBeforeTeardown": all(r["evaluatorBeforeTeardown"] for r in rows), "terminationCounts": dict(collections.Counter(r["termination"] for r in rows)), "cases": rows}
